title: Artist's Magazine Files Bankruptcy
content: F+W media, publisher ofThe Artists Magazine, Pastel Journal, Watercolor Artist, Writer's DigestandInterweave Knitshas filed for bankruptcy, citing declining print sales and disappointing e-commerce results.The actual storyappears to be more complex, involving a family selling its profitable business to corporate interests who racked up a lot of debt in dubious ventures and acquisitions. (thanks, Bob).-----Publishers Weekly's article on the business travailsWikipedia page with full list of magazinesPreviously:Your Favorite Art Magazines
